canada-dnd-suffield.n: CFB Suffield / Suffield Training Area / DRDC Experimental Proving Ground
canada-dnd-suffield.cp: NRCan Canadian Geographical Names Database (CGNDB) official feature IAAHH (Canadian Forces Base Suffield, MIL). Official named-feature point; not a surveyed installation or range footprint. (place_name_approx)
canada-dnd-suffield.st: Active CFB, British Army Training Unit Suffield (BATUS) host, and DRDC Suffield Research Centre Experimental Proving Ground. A 7 October 2026 National Defence news release says CFB Suffield provides training and testing capabilities and hosts BATUS, and announces $750 million for a new Chemical and Biological Laboratory and Blast Assessment Centre at CFB Suffield. A November 2024 National Defence briefing said construction was commencing on a $44 million Neurobehavioral Blast Research Facility of about 1,400 m2 at DRDC Suffield. No open IAAC public-comment period for Suffield was found on 2026-11-23.
canada-dnd-suffield.what: Coordinates are the official NRCan CGNDB military feature 'Canadian Forces Base Suffield' (IAAHH), not a surveyed footprint of the EPG or BATUS training area. A separately named official CGNDB feature 'Suffield Training Area' (IARXR) is at 50.451389, -110.83889. The 2015 article describes the EPG as more than 470 square kilometres at CFB Suffield and as the largest of its kind in Canada and the United Kingdom. Exact years for Operations Snowball and Prairie Flat were not given in the retrieved official sources, so the date is recorded as the 1960s only.

canada-dnd-petawawa.n: 4 CDSB Petawawa / Petawawa Range and Training Area
canada-dnd-petawawa.cp: NRCan Canadian Geographical Names Database (CGNDB) official feature FEQVS (Petawawa Range and Training Area, MIL). Official named-feature point; not a surveyed installation or range footprint. (place_name_approx)
canada-dnd-petawawa.st: Active Canadian Army support base and range/training area. The official page says Garrison Petawawa is home to 2 Canadian Mechanized Brigade Group, the Canadian Special Operations Regiment, 1 Canadian Field Hospital, 450 Tactical Helicopter Squadron, 427 Special Operations Aviation Squadron, and other units, and that 4 CDSB Operations Services deals with ranges and training areas management. A November 2024 National Defence briefing cited completion of a new $319 million Canadian Special Operations Regiment facility at CFB Petawawa. No open IAAC public-comment period for Petawawa was found on 2026-11-23.
canada-dnd-petawawa.what: Coordinates are the official NRCan CGNDB military feature 'Petawawa Range and Training Area' (FEQVS), not a surveyed footprint. A separately named official feature 'Canadian Forces Base Petawawa' (FAACH) is at 45.915833, -77.293889. The official DND UXO Legacy Sites inventory includes a related record, Petawawa - Ottawa River (ON900-189 / 0335-X008), with status Risk Mitigation Ongoing; that legacy record is kept as its own canada_sites.json entry (canada-on900-189) and is not merged into this active-base record. No official incident narrative for a specific munitions accident at Petawawa was retrieved from the Government of Canada pages checked for this pass.
